gap: No result ChatGPT got says that the Synology DS225+ (recommended in all three chats with a generic '2 × 4 TB NAS HDD' setup) has only been able to build storage pools on non-Synology hard drives since DSM 7.3 (Synology, October 8, 2025). M.2 pools and caches still need drives on Synology's compatibility list. It also doesn't say that Plex's paywall on remote streaming covers only video, so Plexamp music streaming is not affected.
standout_why: Compared against the cited rival pages: Plex 'Sonic Analysis for Music', which covers x86-only, Plex Pass for the server admin, PMS v1.24.0+ and no FreeBSD/TrueNAS; Plex 'Plex Media Server Requirements'; Navidrome Overview; and UGREEN's Navidrome guide, which already says the DH2300 has no Docker. I also compared against the uncited top results (Navidrome Docker docs, QNAP and Plex NAS pages). None of them states Synology's drive policy for the 2025 Plus series or the DSM version that lifts it. All three ChatGPT answers present Plex Pass as optional or needed for offline downloads. None says that remote Plexamp music streaming is outside the April 2025 remote-playback requirement. Our current page has neither fact.
decides: This confirms the DS225+ as a pick only if DSM is on 7.3 or later before the pool is built with third-party HDDs such as IronWolf or WD Red. Keep the SSD-for-database advice for the UGREEN DXP2800 or QNAP TS-264. Synology's DS225+ spec lists only two SATA bays and no M.2, and its M.2 pools need drives on Synology's compatibility list anyway. Plex's remote-streaming paywall covers only video, so Plexamp music isn't affected. The Navidrome-vs-Plexamp choice therefore comes down to Sonic Analysis (x86 plus Plex Pass), not remote-streaming cost. That supports an x86 box (DXP2800, DS225+ or TS-264) over the ARM DH2300.

findings.label: Plex Sonic Analysis platform limits
findings.value: x86/x86-64 only (ARM unsupported except M1 Macs via Rosetta 2); Windows, macOS or 64-bit Linux; PMS v1.24.0+; Plex Pass on the server admin account; FreeBSD/FreeNAS/TrueNAS not supported (Docker suggested instead); sonic features only in Plexamp
findings.source_title: Sonic Analysis for Music | Plex Support
findings.note: A rival already cites this. It is included for the compatibility matrix and doesn't count as new.

findings.label: Navidrome Docker image architectures
findings.value: linux/amd64, linux/arm/v6, linux/arm/v7, linux/arm64; examples map port 4533
findings.note: So Navidrome runs on every candidate that has Docker, ARM or x86.
